trust_decision.summary: Bracketed query-string keys from the page URL are trusted as container paths when the client rebuilds #[Url]/$queryString state; nested containers are plain {} so a __proto__/constructor segment writes into Object.prototype, and effect handlers then trust inherited (non-own) keys on the server effects object (html, js, xjs, scripts, redirect, download...) as if the server had sent them.

landing_point.why: The summary says client-side state handling plus prototype pollution; the only query-string-to-object parser is fromQueryString, and it already has a comment about Object.create(null) and XSS at :277-279.

fix_sites.entry_point: Page load with a URL query string for a #[Url] property (supportQueryString effect -> track -> has/get), the $queryString Alpine magic, and the public Alpine.history.track API
fix_sites.module_kind: pollution source: history plugin query-string parser

fix_sites.entry_point: Every server commit response or initial render effects (effect hook)

fix_sites.module_kind: gadget: Echo integration (looks out of scope)

fix_sites.entry_point: inscribeSnapshotAndEffectsOnElement (save of effects into wire:effects attribute, re-read on re-init)
fix_sites.module_kind: save/reload: effects serialized back to DOM attribute

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: js/component.js:169-183 (originalEffects inherited keys copied into the wire:effects attribute and re-parsed at js/component.js:28); also gadget sites in feature modules such as js/features/supportLaravelEcho.js:11 and js/request/commit.js:122

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Once the parser in the history plugin is fixed there is no pollution, so the 13 effect readers in unrelated feature files 'only consume trusted server JSON' and look like defence-in-depth, not part of the bug.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Nested object/array #[Url] values must keep round-tripping through bracketed query strings (filters[startDate]=..., foo[bar]=baz, items[0][0]=foo); a fix that rejects bracket keys or flattens containers breaks them. Also falsy/empty effects (listeners [], no html) must still be skipped.

O6_input_shapes: key segment __proto__ at any nesting depth (foo[__proto__][x])
object containers vs numeric array containers (isNaN(second) branch)
inherited keys read through dot access and bracket access on effects (effects.html, effects['redirect'])

O7_producer.where: js/component.js:169-183 writes effects into wire:effects; js/morph.js:35-37 also re-serializes component.effects

O8_uncovered_routes.route: dataSet dot-notation writer creates plain {} containers and walks any segment including __proto__/constructor; reached by applyUpdates with diff paths and by $wire.$set / wire:model
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Keys are property paths from developer templates or the client's own diff, not from the URL the advisory talks about.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file (js/utils.js) from js/plugins/history/index.js; callers in js/component.js:112, js/$wire.js:144, js/directives/wire-model.js:52

O8_uncovered_routes.route: component snapshot memo is read by non-own lookups (memo.lazyLoaded, memo.isolate) in other feature hooks that the fix did not change
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: memo is not an effects object and controls loading mode, not an HTML/JS sink.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second bracket/dot path builder (e.g. for wire:model array keys or $wire.$set paths) that copies the pre-fix container-creation idiom
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: dataSet already uses the same data[first] === undefined -> {} idiom as the vulnerable parser, so a maintainer writing a sibling would copy it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a new effect reader that reads an effect key through plain property access
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Every feature module reads effects/memo with plain property access; a new feature hook in the same style is the house idiom.

O9_family: prototype pollution (CWE-1321) chained to DOM XSS through inherited-property gadgets in effect handlers (CWE-79)
